name: ESOI tools in Python
vision_statement: A repository's intent records are checked, its alternatives measured and its best implementation selected by the esoi Python package, so humans need only review metrics (and can still add value to implementations).
opportunity: Tools open what documents cannot: the automatic use of the best implementation by checks, measurement, selection and a review tracker, which AI can scale across projects. A checker, a measurement harness, a leaderboard and a selector are each a rich creative space of their own, with alternatives to compare, which goes outside what the top solution (applying ESOI by documents and templates) defines and deserves focused attention and iteration.
